title: Amelia evaluated at the Treffert Center

tellings.quote: you know the the tord center there you know because that's where darl trefford

plain: A girl named Amelia, one of the children in a documentary about nonspeaking children said to show telepathy, is said to have been assessed in the 2020s at the Treffert Center in Wisconsin, a centre named after the researcher of savants Darold Treffert. The psychiatrist Diane Powell, who studies these children, mentions it on the show without naming a source, pointing to "the Treffert center there... because that's where Darold Treffert" worked. The point is that an outside expert centre looked at the girl's abilities.
